Lines are every line of every .rs under the path but its `#[cfg(test)]` items; a path not built yet passes; a row beneath another row's directory is counted against itself alone (a `<dir>/*` row per file, a `<dir>` row its whole tree). A row split from another is its lines at the split plus 15% (`core/tactics` 5 more for `tactics::engage`, `sim/src/duel` 15 more for its real side's hooks, `sim/src/duel/real` its 138 lines), and the row it left its remaining lines plus the headroom it had. comments: the most percent of a src directory's own lines that are `//` comments, by the directory, else `_default`. counts: the most a per-tick count the bot reports in its observe segment (ARCHITECTURE.md §9.3) may stand at, over a scenario's whole run: `floodsMost` the floods one tick ran, `atlasMissRate` the percent of `fieldOn` lookups that flooded, `threatLookupsMost` the tiles a Hunt scored in one tick (nine a body of the largest set, eight). `npm run scenario` asserts them.
